blends.name: AXOLOTL SATOSHIP Sticker
blends.desc:
Time to blend the Axolotl Satoship Sticker!

Burn your 5 common Axolotl Stickers to create a rare Axolotl Satoship Sticker. 
Only 60 available.
Will have use case in the game and governance soon.

But it might be temporary as it is highly unstable material!!

Use 10 Cosmic Sparks to fusion 1 Rainbow Spark.

blends.name: Fire Topaz
blends.desc:
Hey GALAKTIKANS and legends from all over the Galaxy!!!

The epic Fire Topaz can now be crafted!

It requires to fusion 15 Sparks, 5 Cosmic Spark, 1 Rainbow Spark and 1 Helior Quartz.
Max quantity is 222.

Krystals are found across the galaxies and some are rarer than others.
Krystals have many uses including fusion crafting, powering spaceships for missions and storing information.
Have fun and start collecting these treasures.
